name: Moon Pong
author: Om Rawaley
description: Pong against the computer. Hold the on-screen arrows (or Up/Down on a keyboard or pad) to move your paddle. A LÖVE game on the Lua App engine.

descriptions.en: Pong against the computer. Hold the on-screen arrows (or Up/Down on a keyboard or pad) to move your paddle. A LÖVE game on the Lua App engine.
descriptions.it: Pong contro il computer. Tieni premute le frecce sullo schermo (o Su/Giù su tastiera o joypad) per muovere la racchetta. Un gioco LÖVE sul motore Lua App.
